about: What lab-automation users value beyond time saved (#92): monitoring, recovery, dry runs, tuning and sample tracking (#156), per liquid handler. Values come from data/handler-features-research.json (5 Nov 2026), each true or false with a URL and a quote; null means not found in a source that could be read, never 'absent'. Programming route and PyLabRobot support are #82.

liquidLevelDetection.label: Liquid-level detection
liquidLevelDetection.why: Finds the liquid surface (capacitive or pressure), so short volumes and empty wells are caught instead of aspirating air.

clotOrAirDetection.label: Clot, air or foam detection
clotOrAirDetection.why: Pressure monitoring during aspiration flags clots, bubbles and empty aspirations: the errors that silently ruin a well.

tipPresence.label: Tip presence check
tipPresence.why: Confirms a tip was picked up before it is used.

camera.label: Camera or barcode reader
camera.why: Lets someone see the run or check labware and samples remotely.

remoteMonitoring.label: Remote monitoring and alerts
remoteMonitoring.why: Tells someone away from the bench that the run stopped, so walk-away time is real.

errorRecovery.label: Guided error recovery
errorRecovery.why: Retry, skip or fix a step mid-run instead of losing the plate.

simulator.label: Dry-run simulator
simulator.why: Runs the protocol in software before any reagent is used.

liquidClasses.label: Tunable liquid classes
liquidClasses.why: Per-reagent aspirate and dispense settings for viscous, volatile or bead-laden liquids.

overnightUnattended.label: Stated for unattended or overnight runs
overnightUnattended.why: The maker says it can run unattended (enclosure, walk-away operation).

userBase.label: Stated user base or protocol library
userBase.why: Shared protocols and a large community shorten setup.

barcodeReading.label: Barcode reading
barcodeReading.why: Reads plate and tube barcodes on load, so samples are tracked without typing them in. A handheld scanner counts; the detail says which.

limsIntegration.label: LIMS or ELN integration
limsIntegration.why: Sends and receives sample lists and results from a LIMS or ELN instead of copying files by hand.

auditTrail.label: Audit trail
auditTrail.why: Records who ran what, with which settings, and what went wrong: needed for traceable runs and regulated work.
